description: Enerdata offers the EMEA LNG Projects & Plants | EMEA LNG Dataset as a one-time regional export in its energy dataset catalogue. The product page identifies countries separately for liquefaction and regasification. It describes terminal capacities, tanks, commissioning dates, facility types, operators and shareholders, together with LNG carrier attributes such as IMO identifier, status, capacity and trading destinations. These fields support gas infrastructure capacity planning and LNG transport representations. The global service counts shown on the page are not counts for this regional export. The vendor defines the covered country list; region names do not establish complete continental coverage. Access requires paid purchase through the provider; no purchase was made. The exact delivered file extension, measurement coverage dates and contractual licence were not established from the metadata reviewed. Caveats include changing project status and the distinction between a purchased export and the broader subscription service described on the page. Related records include the Enerdata hydrogen and derivatives projects database, a separate product with different infrastructure scope.
